tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.25;
father of: Azmaveth (H5820J)
§ Adiel = "ornament of God"
1) a prince of the Simeon of the family of Shimei in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah
2) a priest, ancestor of Maasiai
3) ancestor of Azmaveth, the treasurer of David

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Adiel, the name of three Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H5716 (עֲדִי) and H410 (אֵל); ornament of God;
